All three challenges have been refuted by the evidence:

H1 (Adjusted Operating Profit): The evidence shows that adjusted operating profit margin also declined from 20.7% in 2024 to 17.2% in 2025 (E1), indicating that even on an adjusted basis, operating profit decreased rather than increased. This is consistent across all quarterly periods examined.

The claim refers to Caterpillar's operating profit generally, not a specific segment, and the consolidated figure clearly declined.

H3 (One-Time Charges Masking Growth): Even after excluding restructuring costs, the adjusted operating profit margin declined from 20.7% to 17.2% (E1). Restructuring costs were actually lower in 2025 ($126M for nine months) than in 2024 ($158M for nine months) per E19, so they cannot explain the decline.
